resources.string: Enter subscription ID
Enter subscription ID

Paste your subscription ID (it starts with sub_ and is shown on the page after checkout) or the transaction ID from Paddle\'s invoice (it starts with txn_). Lost both? Paddle\'s email about your subscription has a link to update your payment method: copy that link (not the one to cancel) and paste it here, the ID is in it. The address of your subscription\'s page in Paddle\'s customer portal works too, as does a transaction ID from its payments. If you still cannot find an ID, tap \"Send report to developer\" in Settings. A Google Play subscription only works in the Google Play version of this app.
